mentions.name: Web-reader MCP tool
mentions.description: This is a self-built web-reader tool designed to be hooked into an LLM as an MCP server, created as a do-it-yourself alternative to commercial offerings. It fetches web page content for LLM use, and its author has found the web hostile to it: roughly 50% of sites block requests that don't come from residential IPs, presumably in response to mass scraping.
mentions.problem: Building a usable web reader is difficult because around half of sites block any traffic not originating from a residential IP, apparently as a response to mass scraping.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a web-reader tool of the kinda you might hook into an LLM as a MCP. Wanted to see how far I can get on my own rather than using something commercial.
mentions.author: Havoc
